Located between Portland, Auburn, Brunswick and Freeport, Cunningham Farm is primarily used as a venue for estate, barn and outdoor weddings. The property boasts more than 90 acres of land inclusive of three event barns, a farmhouse, a pond, a river, a meandering brook, rock walls, and an iconic tree farm - complete with a white farm fence - there couldn’t be a more beautiful property to serve as a backdrop for your magical day.
